description_en: Calls the DiagnoseVpnGateway operation to perform a one-click diagnosis on a specified VPN gateway instance
description_zh: 调用DiagnoseVpnGateway接口一键诊断指定的VPN网关实例
kebab_example: aliyun vpc diagnose-vpn-gateway --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-id vco-uf66xniofskqtuoz10000 --resource-type IPsec --vpn-gateway-id vpn-m5efhj0k1p47ctuhl0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DiagnoseVpnGateway

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the VPN gateway instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
VPN网关实例所属的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource to be diagnosed
parameters.name: resource_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the resource to be diagnosed.

Set the value to IPsec, which indicates an IPsec-VPN connection
parameters.help_zh:
待诊断的资源类型。

仅取值：IPsec，表示IPsec连接
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the VPN gateway
parameters.name: vpn_gateway_id

parameters.help_en:
Checks private network connectivity between specified addresses. Valid values:

PrivateSourceIp: the source IP address. The source IP address must be an address on the VPC side.
PrivateDestinationIp: the destination IP address. The destination IP address must be an address on the on-premises data center side
parameters.help_zh:
检查指定地址间的私网连通性。取值：

PrivateSourceIp：源IP地址。源IP地址需为VPC侧的地址。
PrivateDestinationIp：目的IP地址。目的IP地址需为本地数据中心侧的地址
parameters.name: ipsec_extend_info

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The ClientToken value can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may be different for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

DiagnoseId.description_en:
The diagnosis ID.

After this operation returns the diagnosis ID, you can call the [GetVpnGatewayDiagnoseResult]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2521963.html） operation to query the diagnostic report
DiagnoseId.description_zh:
诊断ID。

当前接口返回诊断ID后，您可以调用[GetVpnGatewayDiagnoseResult]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2521963.html）接口查询诊断报告
